Saved Views is available today for every workspace on a paid plan. If you've ever rebuilt the same filtered list, sort order, or grouping every morning, this feature removes that repeated setup. Now you can save any configuration of filters, sorting, and grouping as a named view, then return to it in one click whenever you need it.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans at no extra cost, so your whole team gets access as soon as you upgrade or if you're already subscribed. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize views by project, priority, status, or personal workflow without running out of space.

Views aren't limited to your own screen, either. You can share any saved view with your team, so everyone works from the same filtered list instead of recreating it individually. This keeps standups, sprint planning, and status reviews consistent across the board.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
